steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Both Christianity and Islam teach that humans have a duty to care for the environment, though they use different language. Christians talk about stewardship ; Muslims talk about khalifah (stewardship/guardianship). | RS Exam Tips — Stewardship and the Environment: 1. For Stewardship and the Environment questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
